+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class IngestResult:
+    outcome: str
+    dedupe_key: str
+    incremental_qty: Decimal = ZERO
+    order_status: OrderStatus | None = None
+    position: PositionFillState | None = None
+    drift: ReconciliationDrift | None = None
+
+    @property
+    def duplicate(self) -> bool:
+        return self.outcome == "DUPLICATE"
+
+
+class FillProcessor:
+    """Apply normalized executions and lifecycle updates to a scoped ledger."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        writer: ScopedWriter,
+        clock: Callable[[], datetime] | Any,
+        notification_callback: Callable[[Mapping[str, Any]], None] | None = None,
+    ):
+        self._writer = writer
+        self._clock = clock
+        self._journal = DomainEventJournal(writer.connection, clock=clock)
+        self._notify = notification_callback
+
+    def ingest(self, event: FillEvent | OrderUpdateEvent) -> IngestResult:
+        if not isinstance(event, (FillEvent, OrderUpdateEvent)):
+            raise TypeError("event must be FillEvent or OrderUpdateEvent")
+        scope = self._writer.account_scope_id
+        key = self._dedupe_key(event)
+        now_method = getattr(self._clock, "now", None)
+        now = _utc(now_method() if callable(now_method) else self._clock())
+        notification: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None
+        with self._writer.unit_of_work() as conn:
+            if conn.execute(
+                "SELECT 1 FROM broker_activities WHERE account_scope_id=? "
+                "AND external_activity_id=?",
+                (scope, key),
+            ).fetchone():
+                return IngestResult("DUPLICATE", key)
+            conn.execute(
+                "INSERT INTO broker_activities(broker_activity_id,account_scope_id,"
+                "external_activity_id,activity_type,payload_json,occurred_at,recorded_at) "
+                "VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
+                (
+                    uuid4().hex,
+                    scope,
+                    key,
+                    event.event_type if isinstance(event, FillEvent) else "ORDER_UPDATE",
+                    canonical_payload_json(self._payload(event)),
+                    to_db_timestamp(event.occurred_at),
+                    to_db_timestamp(now),
+                ),
+            )
+            order = conn.execute(
+                "SELECT broker_order_id,intent_id,symbol,side,status,quantity,filled_quantity,"
+                "filled_avg_price,client_order_id FROM broker_orders "
+                "WHERE account_scope_id=? AND client_order_id=?",
+                (scope, event.client_order_id),
+            ).fetchone()
+            if order is None:
+                drift = self._drift(
+                    conn, key, event, now, "UNKNOWN_CLIENT_ORDER", {}, self._payload(event)
+                )
+                self._emit(
+                    "UnmanagedFillObserved"
+                    if isinstance(event, FillEvent)
+                    else "UnmanagedOrderUpdateObserved",
+                    event.client_order_id,
+                    self._payload(event),
+                    event.occurred_at,
+                    f"fill-ingest:{key}",
+                )
+                return IngestResult("UNMANAGED", key, drift=drift)
+            (
+                broker_id,
+                intent_id,
+                symbol,
+                side_text,
+                raw_status,
+                raw_order_qty,
+                raw_filled,
+                raw_avg,
+                _,
+            ) = order
+            if event.broker_order_id and event.broker_order_id != broker_id:
+                drift = self._drift(
+                    conn,
+                    key,
+                    event,
+                    now,
+                    "ORDER_ID_MISMATCH",
+                    {"broker_order_id": broker_id},
+                    self._payload(event),
+                )
+                self._emit(
+                    "FillOrderMismatchObserved",
+                    event.client_order_id,
+                    self._payload(event),
+                    event.occurred_at,
+                    f"fill-ingest:{key}",
+                )
+                return IngestResult("DRIFT", key, drift=drift)
+            current = self._fsm_status(raw_status)
+            if isinstance(event, FillEvent):
+                result, notification = self._apply_fill(conn, event, order, current, now, key)
+            elif (
+                self._target_status(event.status)
+                in {OrderStatus.PARTIALLY_FILLED, OrderStatus.FILLED}
+                and event.cumulative_qty is not None
+                and event.cumulative_qty > decimal_from_db(raw_filled)
+            ):
+                fill_event = FillEvent(
+                    client_order_id=event.client_order_id,
+                    event_id=event.event_id,
+                    broker_order_id=event.broker_order_id,
+                    occurred_at=event.occurred_at,
+                    cumulative_qty=event.cumulative_qty,
+                    average_price=event.average_price,
+                )
+                result, notification = self._apply_fill(conn, fill_event, order, current, now, key)
+            else:
+                result = self._apply_status(conn, event, order, current, now, key)
+        if notification is not None and self._notify is not None:
+            self._notify(notification)
+        return result
+
+    def _dedupe_key(self, event: FillEvent | OrderUpdateEvent) -> str:
+        if event.event_id:
+            return f"provider:{event.event_id}"
+        payload = self._payload(event)
+        raw = canonical_payload_json(payload)
+        return "composite:" + hashlib.sha256(raw.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _payload(event: FillEvent | OrderUpdateEvent) -> dict[str, Any]:
+        values = {name: getattr(event, name) for name in event.__dataclass_fields__}
+        return values
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _fsm_status(raw: str) -> OrderStatus:
+        mapping = {
+            "NEW": OrderStatus.PENDING,
+            "PENDING_NEW": OrderStatus.PENDING,
+            "PENDING_CANCEL": OrderStatus.CANCEL_PENDING,
+        }
+        if raw in mapping:
+            return mapping[raw]
+        try:
+            return OrderStatus(raw)
+        except ValueError:
+            return OrderStatus.UNKNOWN
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _broker_status(status: OrderStatus) -> str:
+        return {
+            OrderStatus.PENDING: "PENDING_NEW",
+            OrderStatus.CANCEL_PENDING: "PENDING_CANCEL",
+        }.get(status, status.value)
+
+    def _apply_status(self, conn, event, order, current, now, key) -> IngestResult:
+        status = self._target_status(event.status)
+        transition = apply_transition(
+            current,
+            OrderEvent(
+                status, broker_lookup=event.broker_lookup, broker_confirmed=event.broker_confirmed
+            ),
+        )
+        if transition.accepted:
+            conn.execute(
+                "UPDATE broker_orders SET status=?,updated_at=? WHERE account_scope_id=? "
+                "AND broker_order_id=?",
+                (
+                    self._broker_status(status),
+                    to_db_timestamp(event.occurred_at),
+                    self._writer.account_scope_id,
+                    order[0],
+                ),
+            )
+            if status in {
+                OrderStatus.CANCELED,
+                OrderStatus.EXPIRED,
+                OrderStatus.REJECTED,
+                OrderStatus.REPLACED,
+            }:
+                self._release_reservation(conn, order[1], now)
+        self._emit(
+            "OrderUpdateIngested",
+            order[0],
+            {
+                "dedupe_key": key,
+                "status": status.value,
+                "applied": transition.accepted,
+                "outcome": transition.outcome,
+            },
+            event.occurred_at,
+            f"fill-ingest:{key}",
+        )
+        return IngestResult(
+            "APPLIED" if transition.accepted else "RECORDED", key, order_status=transition.status
+        )
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _target_status(raw: str | OrderStatus) -> OrderStatus:
+        if isinstance(raw, OrderStatus):
+            return raw
+        mapping = {
+            "NEW": OrderStatus.PENDING,
+            "PENDING_NEW": OrderStatus.PENDING,
+            "PENDING_CANCEL": OrderStatus.CANCEL_PENDING,
+        }
+        value = str(raw).upper()
+        if value in mapping:
+            return mapping[value]
+        return OrderStatus(value)
+
+    def _apply_fill(self, conn, event, order, current, now, key):
+        scope = self._writer.account_scope_id
+        broker_id, intent_id, symbol, side_text, _, raw_order_qty, raw_filled, raw_avg, _ = order
+        side = OrderSide(side_text)
+        quantity = decimal_from_db(raw_filled)
+        old_avg = ZERO if raw_avg is None else decimal_from_db(raw_avg)
+        cumulative = event.cumulative_qty
+        delta = (cumulative - quantity) if cumulative is not None else (event.quantity or ZERO)
+        if delta < ZERO:
+            delta = ZERO
+        if delta == ZERO:
+            self._emit(
+                "FillUpdateIngested",
+                broker_id,
+                {"dedupe_key": key, "incremental_qty": ZERO, "cumulative_qty": cumulative},
+                event.occurred_at,
+                f"fill-ingest:{key}",
+            )
+            return IngestResult("RECORDED", key, order_status=current), None
+        price = event.price if event.price is not None else event.average_price
+        if price is None or price <= ZERO:
+            raise ValueError("a positive fill requires a positive price")
+        new_qty = quantity + delta
+        if new_qty > decimal_from_db(raw_order_qty):
+            drift = self._drift(
+                conn,
+                key,
+                event,
+                now,
+                "FILL_EXCEEDS_ORDER_QTY",
+                {"max_qty": raw_order_qty},
+                {"new_qty": new_qty},
+            )
+            self._emit(
+                "FillQuantityDriftObserved",
+                broker_id,
+                {"dedupe_key": key, "drift_id": drift.drift_id},
+                event.occurred_at,
+                f"fill-ingest:{key}",
+            )
+            return IngestResult("DRIFT", key, drift=drift), None
+        if cumulative is not None and event.average_price is not None:
+            new_cost = cumulative * event.average_price
+            incremental_cost = new_cost - quantity * old_avg
+            price = incremental_cost / delta if incremental_cost >= ZERO else event.average_price
+        else:
+            incremental_cost = delta * price
+            new_cost = quantity * old_avg + incremental_cost
+        target = (
+            OrderStatus.FILLED
+            if new_qty == decimal_from_db(raw_order_qty)
+            else OrderStatus.PARTIALLY_FILLED
+        )
+        transitioned = apply_transition(current, OrderEvent(target, filled_qty=delta))
+        next_status = transitioned.status if not transitioned.illegal else current
+        cycle_id = None
+        if intent_id is not None:
+            row = conn.execute(
+                "SELECT cycle_id FROM order_intents WHERE account_scope_id=? AND intent_id=?",
+                (scope, intent_id),
+            ).fetchone()
+            cycle_id = row[0] if row else None
+        position, drift = self._change_position(
+            conn, event, order, cycle_id, side, delta, price, now, key
+        )
+        if drift is not None:
+            return IngestResult("DRIFT", key, drift=drift), None
+        conn.execute(
+            "INSERT INTO fills(fill_id,account_scope_id,external_activity_id,broker_order_id,"
+            "cycle_id,symbol,side,quantity,price,fee,filled_at,recorded_at) "
+            "VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
+            (
+                f"{scope}:{key}",
+                scope,
+                key,
+                broker_id,
+                cycle_id,
+                symbol,
+                side.value,
+                decimal_to_db(delta),
+                decimal_to_db(price),
+                decimal_to_db(event.fee),
+                to_db_timestamp(event.occurred_at),
+                to_db_timestamp(now),
+            ),
+        )
+        conn.execute(
+            "UPDATE broker_orders SET status=?,filled_quantity=?,filled_avg_price=?,updated_at=? "
+            "WHERE account_scope_id=? AND broker_order_id=?",
+            (
+                self._broker_status(next_status),
+                decimal_to_db(new_qty),
+                decimal_to_db(new_cost / new_qty),
+                to_db_timestamp(event.occurred_at),
+                scope,
+                broker_id,
+            ),
+        )
+        self._settle_entry_reservation(
+            conn, intent_id, delta, price, quantity, old_avg, new_qty, raw_order_qty, now
+        )
+        self._emit(
+            "FillApplied",
+            cycle_id or broker_id,
+            {
+                "dedupe_key": key,
+                "broker_order_id": broker_id,
+                "client_order_id": event.client_order_id,
+                "symbol": symbol,
+                "side": side,
+                "incremental_qty": delta,
+                "cumulative_qty": new_qty,
+                "price": price,
+                "remaining_quantity": position.remaining_qty if position else ZERO,
+            },
+            event.occurred_at,
+            f"fill-ingest:{key}",
+        )
+        notice = {
+            "type": "positive-fill-confirmed",
+            "client_order_id": event.client_order_id,
+            "broker_order_id": broker_id,
+            "symbol": symbol,
+            "side": side.value,
+            "incremental_qty": delta,
+            "remaining_qty": position.remaining_qty if position else ZERO,
+            "cycle_id": cycle_id,
+        }
+        return IngestResult("APPLIED", key, delta, next_status, position), notice
+
+    def _change_position(self, conn, event, order, cycle_id, side, delta, price, now, key):
+        scope = self._writer.account_scope_id
+        symbol = order[2]
+        if event.symbol and event.symbol.upper() != symbol:
+            raise ValueError("fill symbol does not match order")
+        if event.side is not None and event.side is not side:
+            raise ValueError("fill side does not match order")
+        row = conn.execute(
+            "SELECT quantity,average_entry_price FROM positions "
+            "WHERE account_scope_id=? AND symbol=?",
+            (scope, symbol),
+        ).fetchone()
+        held = decimal_from_db(row[0]) if row else ZERO
+        avg = decimal_from_db(row[1]) if row else ZERO
+        cost = held * avg
+        if side is OrderSide.SELL and delta > held:
+            drift = self._drift(
+                conn,
+                key,
+                event,
+                now,
+                "CRITICAL_OVERSELL",
+                {"held_qty": held},
+                {"sell_qty": delta, "client_order_id": event.client_order_id},
+            )
+            if cycle_id:
+                conn.execute(
+                    "UPDATE position_cycles SET state='EXITING',updated_at=? "
+                    "WHERE account_scope_id=? AND cycle_id=? AND state!='CLOSED'",
+                    (to_db_timestamp(now), scope, cycle_id),
+                )
+            return None, drift
+        new_held = held + delta if side is OrderSide.BUY else held - delta
+        new_cost = cost + delta * price if side is OrderSide.BUY else cost - avg * delta
+        if new_held == ZERO:
+            if cycle_id:
+                conn.execute(
+                    "UPDATE position_cycles SET state='CLOSED',closed_at=?,updated_at=? "
+                    "WHERE account_scope_id=? AND cycle_id=?",
+                    (to_db_timestamp(event.occurred_at), to_db_timestamp(now), scope, cycle_id),
+                )
+            conn.execute(
+                "DELETE FROM positions WHERE account_scope_id=? AND symbol=?", (scope, symbol)
+            )
+            return PositionFillState(cycle_id or "", symbol, ZERO, ZERO, None), None
+        average = new_cost / new_held
+        if cycle_id:
+            state = "OPEN" if side is OrderSide.BUY else "EXITING"
+            conn.execute(
+                "UPDATE position_cycles SET state=?,opened_at=COALESCE(opened_at,?),updated_at=? "
+                "WHERE account_scope_id=? AND cycle_id=?",
+                (state, to_db_timestamp(event.occurred_at), to_db_timestamp(now), scope, cycle_id),
+            )
+        conn.execute(
+            "INSERT INTO positions(account_scope_id,symbol,cycle_id,management,direction,"
+            "quantity,average_entry_price,market_price,market_value,unrealized_pl,as_of) "
+            "VALUES (?,?,?,'MANAGED','LONG',?,?,NULL,NULL,NULL,?) "
+            "ON CONFLICT(account_scope_id,symbol) DO UPDATE SET "
+            "cycle_id=excluded.cycle_id,management='MANAGED',direction='LONG',"
+            "quantity=excluded.quantity,average_entry_price=excluded.average_entry_price,"
+            "as_of=excluded.as_of",
+            (
+                scope,
+                symbol,
+                cycle_id,
+                decimal_to_db(new_held),
+                decimal_to_db(average),
+                to_db_timestamp(event.occurred_at),
+            ),
+        )
+        return PositionFillState(cycle_id or "", symbol, new_held, new_cost, average), None
+
+    def _settle_entry_reservation(
+        self, conn, intent_id, delta, price, prior_qty, prior_avg, new_qty, raw_order_qty, now
+    ):
+        if not intent_id:
+            return
+        scope = self._writer.account_scope_id
+        intent = conn.execute(
+            "SELECT side,quantity,notional FROM order_intents "
+            "WHERE account_scope_id=? AND intent_id=?",
+            (scope, intent_id),
+        ).fetchone()
+        if not intent or intent[0] != "BUY":
+            return
+        reservation_id = f"rsv:{intent_id}"
+        row = conn.execute(
+            "SELECT amount,state FROM budget_reservations "
+            "WHERE account_scope_id=? AND reservation_id=?",
+            (scope, reservation_id),
+        ).fetchone()
+        if not row or row[1] != "ACTIVE":
+            return
+        remainder = decimal_from_db(row[0])
+        target = decimal_from_db(intent[1]) if intent[1] is not None else decimal_from_db(intent[2])
+        share = (
+            delta / (target - prior_qty)
+            if intent[1] is not None and target > prior_qty
+            else (delta * price) / (target - prior_qty * prior_avg)
+            if target > prior_qty * prior_avg
+            else Decimal("1")
+        )
+        if new_qty >= decimal_from_db(raw_order_qty):
+            conn.execute(
+                "UPDATE budget_reservations SET amount='0',state='CONSUMED',resolved_at=? "
+                "WHERE account_scope_id=? AND reservation_id=?",
+                (to_db_timestamp(now), scope, reservation_id),
+            )
+        else:
+            consumed_fraction = min(Decimal("1"), max(ZERO, share))
+            conn.execute(
+                "UPDATE budget_reservations SET amount=? WHERE account_scope_id=? "
+                "AND reservation_id=?",
+                (
+                    decimal_to_db(remainder * (Decimal("1") - consumed_fraction)),
+                    scope,
+                    reservation_id,
+                ),
+            )
+
+    def _release_reservation(self, conn, intent_id, now):
+        if not intent_id:
+            return
+        conn.execute(
+            "UPDATE budget_reservations SET amount='0',state='RELEASED',resolved_at=? "
+            "WHERE account_scope_id=? AND reservation_id=? AND state='ACTIVE'",
+            (to_db_timestamp(now), self._writer.account_scope_id, f"rsv:{intent_id}"),
+        )
+
+    def _drift(self, conn, key, event, now, kind, expected, actual):
+        scope = self._writer.account_scope_id
+        run_id, drift_id = f"fill:{key}", uuid4().hex
+        if not conn.execute(
+            "SELECT 1 FROM reconciliation_runs WHERE account_scope_id=? "
+            "AND reconciliation_run_id=?",
+            (scope, run_id),
+        ).fetchone():
+            conn.execute(
+                "INSERT INTO reconciliation_runs(reconciliation_run_id,account_scope_id,status,"
+                "started_at,completed_at,summary_json) VALUES (?,?, 'DRIFTED',?,?,?)",
+                (
+                    run_id,
+                    scope,
+                    to_db_timestamp(now),
+                    to_db_timestamp(now),
+                    canonical_payload_json({"source": "fill_processor"}),
+                ),
+            )
+        conn.execute(
+            "INSERT INTO reconciliation_drifts(drift_id,account_scope_id,reconciliation_run_id,"
+            "drift_type,entity_ref,expected_json,actual_json,detected_at) "
+            "VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
+            (
+                drift_id,
+                scope,
+                run_id,
+                kind,
+                event.client_order_id,
+                canonical_payload_json(expected),
+                canonical_payload_json(actual),
+                to_db_timestamp(now),
+            ),
+        )
+        conn.execute(
+            "INSERT INTO entry_controls(account_scope_id,kill_switch_enabled,paused,reason,"
+            "updated_by,updated_at) VALUES (?,1,1,?,?,?) "
+            "ON CONFLICT(account_scope_id) DO UPDATE SET kill_switch_enabled=1,paused=1,"
+            "reason=excluded.reason,updated_by=excluded.updated_by,updated_at=excluded.updated_at",
+            (scope, f"reconciliation drift: {kind}", "fill_processor", to_db_timestamp(now)),
+        )
+        self._emit(
+            "ReconciliationDriftRecorded",
+            run_id,
+            {
+                "drift_id": drift_id,
+                "drift_type": kind,
+                "client_order_id": event.client_order_id,
+                "dedupe_key": key,
+            },
+            event.occurred_at,
+            f"fill-drift:{key}",
+        )
+        return ReconciliationDrift(
+            drift_id, kind, event.client_order_id, {"expected": expected, "actual": actual}
+        )
+
+    def _emit(self, event_type, stream_id, payload, occurred_at, idem):
+        return self._journal.append_in_transaction(
+            [
+                NewEvent(
+                    self._writer.account_scope_id,
+                    "fill_processor",
+                    str(stream_id),
+                    event_type,
+                    payload,
+                    occurred_at,
+                    idempotency_key=idem,
+                )
+            ]
+        )

+from __future__ import annotations

+"""Exactly-once ingestion of normalized order updates and fills."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+from collections.abc import Callable, Mapping
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from datetime import UTC, datetime
+from decimal import Decimal
+from typing import Any
+from uuid import uuid4
+
+from mike_trade.domain.trading import OrderSide
+from mike_trade.execution.order_fsm import OrderEvent, OrderStatus, apply_transition
+from mike_trade.persistence.journal import DomainEventJournal, NewEvent, canonical_payload_json
+from mike_trade.persistence.schema import decimal_from_db, decimal_to_db, to_db_timestamp
+from mike_trade.persistence.transaction import ScopedWriter
+
+__all__ = [
+    "FillProcessor",
+    "IngestResult",
+    "FillEvent",
+    "OrderUpdateEvent",
+    "ReconciliationDrift",
+    "PositionFillState",
+]
+
+ZERO = Decimal("0")
+
+
+def _text(value: object, name: str, *, optional: bool = False) -> str | None:
+    if value is None and optional:
+        return None
+    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a non-empty string")
+    return value.strip()
+
+
+def _decimal(value: Decimal | None, name: str, *, optional: bool = False) -> Decimal | None:
+    if value is None and optional:
+        return None
+    if not isinstance(value, Decimal):
+        raise TypeError(f"{name} must be Decimal")
+    if not value.is_finite() or value < ZERO:
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be finite and non-negative")
+    return value
+
+
+def _utc(value: datetime) -> datetime:
+    if not isinstance(value, datetime) or value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
+        raise ValueError("occurred_at must be timezone-aware")
+    return value.astimezone(UTC)
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class FillEvent:
+    client_order_id: str
+    occurred_at: datetime
+    event_id: str | None = None
+    broker_order_id: str | None = None
+    symbol: str | None = None
+    side: OrderSide | str | None = None
+    quantity: Decimal | None = None
+    cumulative_qty: Decimal | None = None
+    price: Decimal | None = None
+    average_price: Decimal | None = None
+    fee: Decimal = ZERO
+    event_type: str = "FILL"
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        object.__setattr__(self, "client_order_id", _text(self.client_order_id, "client_order_id"))
+        object.__setattr__(self, "event_id", _text(self.event_id, "event_id", optional=True))
+        object.__setattr__(
+            self, "broker_order_id", _text(self.broker_order_id, "broker_order_id", optional=True)
+        )
+        object.__setattr__(self, "symbol", _text(self.symbol, "symbol", optional=True))
+        object.__setattr__(self, "occurred_at", _utc(self.occurred_at))
+        for name in ("quantity", "cumulative_qty", "price", "average_price", "fee"):
+            object.__setattr__(
+                self, name, _decimal(getattr(self, name), name, optional=name != "fee")
+            )
+        if self.side is not None and not isinstance(self.side, OrderSide):
+            try:
+                object.__setattr__(self, "side", OrderSide(str(self.side).upper()))
+            except ValueError as exc:
+                raise ValueError("side must be BUY or SELL") from exc
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class OrderUpdateEvent:
+    client_order_id: str
+    status: str | OrderStatus
+    occurred_at: datetime
+    event_id: str | None = None
+    broker_order_id: str | None = None
+    cumulative_qty: Decimal | None = None
+    average_price: Decimal | None = None
+    broker_confirmed: bool = True
+    broker_lookup: bool = False
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        object.__setattr__(self, "client_order_id", _text(self.client_order_id, "client_order_id"))
+        object.__setattr__(self, "event_id", _text(self.event_id, "event_id", optional=True))
+        object.__setattr__(
+            self, "broker_order_id", _text(self.broker_order_id, "broker_order_id", optional=True)
+        )
+        object.__setattr__(self, "occurred_at", _utc(self.occurred_at))
+        object.__setattr__(
+            self, "cumulative_qty", _decimal(self.cumulative_qty, "cumulative_qty", optional=True)
+        )
+        object.__setattr__(
+            self, "average_price", _decimal(self.average_price, "average_price", optional=True)
+        )
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class PositionFillState:
+    cycle_id: str
+    symbol: str
+    remaining_qty: Decimal
+    cost_basis: Decimal
+    average_price: Decimal | None
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class ReconciliationDrift:
+    drift_id: str
+    drift_type: str
+    client_order_id: str
+    details: Mapping[str, Any]
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class IngestResult:
+    outcome: str
+    dedupe_key: str
+    incremental_qty: Decimal = ZERO
+    order_status: OrderStatus | None = None
+    position: PositionFillState | None = None
+    drift: ReconciliationDrift | None = None
+
+    @property
+    def duplicate(self) -> bool:
+        return self.outcome == "DUPLICATE"
+
+
+class FillProcessor:
+    """Apply normalized executions and lifecycle updates to a scoped ledger."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        writer: ScopedWriter,
+        clock: Callable[[], datetime] | Any,
+        notification_callback: Callable[[Mapping[str, Any]], None] | None = None,
+    ):
+        self._writer = writer
+        self._clock = clock
+        self._journal = DomainEventJournal(writer.connection, clock=clock)
+        self._notify = notification_callback
+
+    def ingest(self, event: FillEvent | OrderUpdateEvent) -> IngestResult:
+        if not isinstance(event, (FillEvent, OrderUpdateEvent)):
+            raise TypeError("event must be FillEvent or OrderUpdateEvent")
+        scope = self._writer.account_scope_id
+        key = self._dedupe_key(event)
+        now_method = getattr(self._clock, "now", None)
+        now = _utc(now_method() if callable(now_method) else self._clock())
+        notification: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None
+        with self._writer.unit_of_work() as conn:
+            if conn.execute(
+                "SELECT 1 FROM broker_activities WHERE account_scope_id=? "
+                "AND external_activity_id=?",
+                (scope, key),
+            ).fetchone():
+                return IngestResult("DUPLICATE", key)
+            conn.execute(
+                "INSERT INTO broker_activities(broker_activity_id,account_scope_id,"
+                "external_activity_id,activity_type,payload_json,occurred_at,recorded_at) "
+                "VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
+                (
+                    uuid4().hex,
+                    scope,
+                    key,
+                    event.event_type if isinstance(event, FillEvent) else "ORDER_UPDATE",
+                    canonical_payload_json(self._payload(event)),
+                    to_db_timestamp(event.occurred_at),
+                    to_db_timestamp(now),
+                ),
+            )
+            order = conn.execute(
+                "SELECT broker_order_id,intent_id,symbol,side,status,quantity,filled_quantity,"
+                "filled_avg_price,client_order_id FROM broker_orders "
+                "WHERE account_scope_id=? AND client_order_id=?",
+                (scope, event.client_order_id),
+            ).fetchone()
+            if order is None:
+                drift = self._drift(
+                    conn, key, event, now, "UNKNOWN_CLIENT_ORDER", {}, self._payload(event)
+                )
+                self._emit(
+                    "UnmanagedFillObserved"
+                    if isinstance(event, FillEvent)
+                    else "UnmanagedOrderUpdateObserved",
+                    event.client_order_id,
+                    self._payload(event),
+                    event.occurred_at,
+                    f"fill-ingest:{key}",
+                )
+                return IngestResult("UNMANAGED", key, drift=drift)
+            (
+                broker_id,
+                intent_id,
+                symbol,
+                side_text,
+                raw_status,
+                raw_order_qty,
+                raw_filled,
+                raw_avg,
+                _,
+            ) = order
+            if event.broker_order_id and event.broker_order_id != broker_id:
+                drift = self._drift(
+                    conn,
+                    key,
+                    event,
+                    now,
+                    "ORDER_ID_MISMATCH",
+                    {"broker_order_id": broker_id},
+                    self._payload(event),
+                )
+                self._emit(
+                    "FillOrderMismatchObserved",
+                    event.client_order_id,
+                    self._payload(event),
+                    event.occurred_at,
+                    f"fill-ingest:{key}",
+                )
+                return IngestResult("DRIFT", key, drift=drift)
+            current = self._fsm_status(raw_status)
+            if isinstance(event, FillEvent):
+                result, notification = self._apply_fill(conn, event, order, current, now, key)
+            elif (
+                self._target_status(event.status)
+                in {OrderStatus.PARTIALLY_FILLED, OrderStatus.FILLED}
+                and event.cumulative_qty is not None
+                and event.cumulative_qty > decimal_from_db(raw_filled)
+            ):
+                fill_event = FillEvent(
+                    client_order_id=event.client_order_id,
+                    event_id=event.event_id,
+                    broker_order_id=event.broker_order_id,
+                    occurred_at=event.occurred_at,
+                    cumulative_qty=event.cumulative_qty,
+                    average_price=event.average_price,
+                )
+                result, notification = self._apply_fill(conn, fill_event, order, current, now, key)
+            else:
+                result = self._apply_status(conn, event, order, current, now, key)
+        if notification is not None and self._notify is not None:
+            self._notify(notification)
+        return result
+
+    def _dedupe_key(self, event: FillEvent | OrderUpdateEvent) -> str:
+        if event.event_id:
+            return f"provider:{event.event_id}"
+        payload = self._payload(event)
+        raw = canonical_payload_json(payload)
+        return "composite:" + hashlib.sha256(raw.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _payload(event: FillEvent | OrderUpdateEvent) -> dict[str, Any]:
+        values = {name: getattr(event, name) for name in event.__dataclass_fields__}
+        return values
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _fsm_status(raw: str) -> OrderStatus:
+        mapping = {
+            "NEW": OrderStatus.PENDING,
+            "PENDING_NEW": OrderStatus.PENDING,
+            "PENDING_CANCEL": OrderStatus.CANCEL_PENDING,
+        }
+        if raw in mapping:
+            return mapping[raw]
+        try:
+            return OrderStatus(raw)
+        except ValueError:
+            return OrderStatus.UNKNOWN
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _broker_status(status: OrderStatus) -> str:
+        return {
+            OrderStatus.PENDING: "PENDING_NEW",
+            OrderStatus.CANCEL_PENDING: "PENDING_CANCEL",
+        }.get(status, status.value)
+
+    def _apply_status(self, conn, event, order, current, now, key) -> IngestResult:
+        status = self._target_status(event.status)
+        transition = apply_transition(
+            current,
+            OrderEvent(
+                status, broker_lookup=event.broker_lookup, broker_confirmed=event.broker_confirmed
+            ),
+        )
+        if transition.accepted:
+            conn.execute(
+                "UPDATE broker_orders SET status=?,updated_at=? WHERE account_scope_id=? "
+                "AND broker_order_id=?",
+                (
+                    self._broker_status(status),
+                    to_db_timestamp(event.occurred_at),
+                    self._writer.account_scope_id,
+                    order[0],
+                ),
+            )
+            if status in {
+                OrderStatus.CANCELED,
+                OrderStatus.EXPIRED,
+                OrderStatus.REJECTED,
+                OrderStatus.REPLACED,
+            }:
+                self._release_reservation(conn, order[1], now)
+        self._emit(
+            "OrderUpdateIngested",
+            order[0],
+            {
+                "dedupe_key": key,
+                "status": status.value,
+                "applied": transition.accepted,
+                "outcome": transition.outcome,
+            },
+            event.occurred_at,
+            f"fill-ingest:{key}",
+        )
+        return IngestResult(
+            "APPLIED" if transition.accepted else "RECORDED", key, order_status=transition.status
+        )
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _target_status(raw: str | OrderStatus) -> OrderStatus:
+        if isinstance(raw, OrderStatus):
+            return raw
+        mapping = {
+            "NEW": OrderStatus.PENDING,
+            "PENDING_NEW": OrderStatus.PENDING,
+            "PENDING_CANCEL": OrderStatus.CANCEL_PENDING,
+        }
+        value = str(raw).upper()
+        if value in mapping:
+            return mapping[value]
+        return OrderStatus(value)
+
+    def _apply_fill(self, conn, event, order, current, now, key):
+        scope = self._writer.account_scope_id
+        broker_id, intent_id, symbol, side_text, _, raw_order_qty, raw_filled, raw_avg, _ = order
+        side = OrderSide(side_text)
+        quantity = decimal_from_db(raw_filled)
+        old_avg = ZERO if raw_avg is None else decimal_from_db(raw_avg)
+        cumulative = event.cumulative_qty
+        delta = (cumulative - quantity) if cumulative is not None else (event.quantity or ZERO)
+        if delta < ZERO:
+            delta = ZERO
+        if delta == ZERO:
+            self._emit(
+                "FillUpdateIngested",
+                broker_id,
+                {"dedupe_key": key, "incremental_qty": ZERO, "cumulative_qty": cumulative},
+                event.occurred_at,
+                f"fill-ingest:{key}",
+            )
+            return IngestResult("RECORDED", key, order_status=current), None
+        price = event.price if event.price is not None else event.average_price
+        if price is None or price <= ZERO:
+            raise ValueError("a positive fill requires a positive price")
+        new_qty = quantity + delta
+        if new_qty > decimal_from_db(raw_order_qty):
+            drift = self._drift(
+                conn,
+                key,
+                event,
+                now,
+                "FILL_EXCEEDS_ORDER_QTY",
+                {"max_qty": raw_order_qty},
+                {"new_qty": new_qty},
+            )
+            self._emit(
+                "FillQuantityDriftObserved",
+                broker_id,
+                {"dedupe_key": key, "drift_id": drift.drift_id},
+                event.occurred_at,
+                f"fill-ingest:{key}",
+            )
+            return IngestResult("DRIFT", key, drift=drift), None
+        if cumulative is not None and event.average_price is not None:
+            new_cost = cumulative * event.average_price
+            incremental_cost = new_cost - quantity * old_avg
+            price = incremental_cost / delta if incremental_cost >= ZERO else event.average_price
+        else:
+            incremental_cost = delta * price
+            new_cost = quantity * old_avg + incremental_cost
+        target = (
+            OrderStatus.FILLED
+            if new_qty == decimal_from_db(raw_order_qty)
+            else OrderStatus.PARTIALLY_FILLED
+        )
+        transitioned = apply_transition(current, OrderEvent(target, filled_qty=delta))
+        next_status = transitioned.status if not transitioned.illegal else current
+        cycle_id = None
+        if intent_id is not None:
+            row = conn.execute(
+                "SELECT cycle_id FROM order_intents WHERE account_scope_id=? AND intent_id=?",
+                (scope, intent_id),
+            ).fetchone()
+            cycle_id = row[0] if row else None
+        position, drift = self._change_position(
+            conn, event, order, cycle_id, side, delta, price, now, key
+        )
+        if drift is not None:
+            return IngestResult("DRIFT", key, drift=drift), None
+        conn.execute(
+            "INSERT INTO fills(fill_id,account_scope_id,external_activity_id,broker_order_id,"
+            "cycle_id,symbol,side,quantity,price,fee,filled_at,recorded_at) "
+            "VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
+            (
+                f"{scope}:{key}",
+                scope,
+                key,
+                broker_id,
+                cycle_id,
+                symbol,
+                side.value,
+                decimal_to_db(delta),
+                decimal_to_db(price),
+                decimal_to_db(event.fee),
+                to_db_timestamp(event.occurred_at),
+                to_db_timestamp(now),
+            ),
+        )
+        conn.execute(
+            "UPDATE broker_orders SET status=?,filled_quantity=?,filled_avg_price=?,updated_at=? "
+            "WHERE account_scope_id=? AND broker_order_id=?",
+            (
+                self._broker_status(next_status),
+                decimal_to_db(new_qty),
+                decimal_to_db(new_cost / new_qty),
+                to_db_timestamp(event.occurred_at),
+                scope,
+                broker_id,
+            ),
+        )
+        self._settle_entry_reservation(
+            conn, intent_id, delta, price, quantity, old_avg, new_qty, raw_order_qty, now
+        )
+        self._emit(
+            "FillApplied",
+            cycle_id or broker_id,
+            {
+                "dedupe_key": key,
+                "broker_order_id": broker_id,
+                "client_order_id": event.client_order_id,
+                "symbol": symbol,
+                "side": side,
+                "incremental_qty": delta,
+                "cumulative_qty": new_qty,
+                "price": price,
+                "remaining_quantity": position.remaining_qty if position else ZERO,
+            },
+            event.occurred_at,
+            f"fill-ingest:{key}",
+        )
+        notice = {
+            "type": "positive-fill-confirmed",
+            "client_order_id": event.client_order_id,
+            "broker_order_id": broker_id,
+            "symbol": symbol,
+            "side": side.value,
+            "incremental_qty": delta,
+            "remaining_qty": position.remaining_qty if position else ZERO,
+            "cycle_id": cycle_id,
+        }
+        return IngestResult("APPLIED", key, delta, next_status, position), notice
+
+    def _change_position(self, conn, event, order, cycle_id, side, delta, price, now, key):
+        scope = self._writer.account_scope_id
+        symbol = order[2]
+        if event.symbol and event.symbol.upper() != symbol:
+            raise ValueError("fill symbol does not match order")
+        if event.side is not None and event.side is not side:
+            raise ValueError("fill side does not match order")
+        row = conn.execute(
+            "SELECT quantity,average_entry_price FROM positions "
+            "WHERE account_scope_id=? AND symbol=?",
+            (scope, symbol),
+        ).fetchone()
+        held = decimal_from_db(row[0]) if row else ZERO
+        avg = decimal_from_db(row[1]) if row else ZERO
+        cost = held * avg
+        if side is OrderSide.SELL and delta > held:
+            drift = self._drift(
+                conn,
+                key,
+                event,
+                now,
+                "CRITICAL_OVERSELL",
+                {"held_qty": held},
+                {"sell_qty": delta, "client_order_id": event.client_order_id},
+            )
+            if cycle_id:
+                conn.execute(
+                    "UPDATE position_cycles SET state='EXITING',updated_at=? "
+                    "WHERE account_scope_id=? AND cycle_id=? AND state!='CLOSED'",
+                    (to_db_timestamp(now), scope, cycle_id),
+                )
+            return None, drift
+        new_held = held + delta if side is OrderSide.BUY else held - delta
+        new_cost = cost + delta * price if side is OrderSide.BUY else cost - avg * delta
+        if new_held == ZERO:
+            if cycle_id:
+                conn.execute(
+                    "UPDATE position_cycles SET state='CLOSED',closed_at=?,updated_at=? "
+                    "WHERE account_scope_id=? AND cycle_id=?",
+                    (to_db_timestamp(event.occurred_at), to_db_timestamp(now), scope, cycle_id),
+                )
+            conn.execute(
+                "DELETE FROM positions WHERE account_scope_id=? AND symbol=?", (scope, symbol)
+            )
+            return PositionFillState(cycle_id or "", symbol, ZERO, ZERO, None), None
+        average = new_cost / new_held
+        if cycle_id:
+            state = "OPEN" if side is OrderSide.BUY else "EXITING"
+            conn.execute(
+                "UPDATE position_cycles SET state=?,opened_at=COALESCE(opened_at,?),updated_at=? "
+                "WHERE account_scope_id=? AND cycle_id=?",
+                (state, to_db_timestamp(event.occurred_at), to_db_timestamp(now), scope, cycle_id),
+            )
+        conn.execute(
+            "INSERT INTO positions(account_scope_id,symbol,cycle_id,management,direction,"
+            "quantity,average_entry_price,market_price,market_value,unrealized_pl,as_of) "
+            "VALUES (?,?,?,'MANAGED','LONG',?,?,NULL,NULL,NULL,?) "
+            "ON CONFLICT(account_scope_id,symbol) DO UPDATE SET "
+            "cycle_id=excluded.cycle_id,management='MANAGED',direction='LONG',"
+            "quantity=excluded.quantity,average_entry_price=excluded.average_entry_price,"
+            "as_of=excluded.as_of",
+            (
+                scope,
+                symbol,
+                cycle_id,
+                decimal_to_db(new_held),
+                decimal_to_db(average),
+                to_db_timestamp(event.occurred_at),
+            ),
+        )
+        return PositionFillState(cycle_id or "", symbol, new_held, new_cost, average), None
+
+    def _settle_entry_reservation(
+        self, conn, intent_id, delta, price, prior_qty, prior_avg, new_qty, raw_order_qty, now
+    ):
+        if not intent_id:
+            return
+        scope = self._writer.account_scope_id
+        intent = conn.execute(
+            "SELECT side,quantity,notional FROM order_intents "
+            "WHERE account_scope_id=? AND intent_id=?",
+            (scope, intent_id),
+        ).fetchone()
+        if not intent or intent[0] != "BUY":
+            return
+        reservation_id = f"rsv:{intent_id}"
+        row = conn.execute(
+            "SELECT amount,state FROM budget_reservations "
+            "WHERE account_scope_id=? AND reservation_id=?",
+            (scope, reservation_id),
+        ).fetchone()
+        if not row or row[1] != "ACTIVE":
+            return
+        remainder = decimal_from_db(row[0])
+        target = decimal_from_db(intent[1]) if intent[1] is not None else decimal_from_db(intent[2])
+        share = (
+            delta / (target - prior_qty)
+            if intent[1] is not None and target > prior_qty
+            else (delta * price) / (target - prior_qty * prior_avg)
+            if target > prior_qty * prior_avg
+            else Decimal("1")
+        )
+        if new_qty >= decimal_from_db(raw_order_qty):
+            conn.execute(
+                "UPDATE budget_reservations SET amount='0',state='CONSUMED',resolved_at=? "
+                "WHERE account_scope_id=? AND reservation_id=?",
+                (to_db_timestamp(now), scope, reservation_id),
+            )
+        else:
+            consumed_fraction = min(Decimal("1"), max(ZERO, share))
+            conn.execute(
+                "UPDATE budget_reservations SET amount=? WHERE account_scope_id=? "
+                "AND reservation_id=?",
+                (
+                    decimal_to_db(remainder * (Decimal("1") - consumed_fraction)),
+                    scope,
+                    reservation_id,
+                ),
+            )
+
+    def _release_reservation(self, conn, intent_id, now):
+        if not intent_id:
+            return
+        conn.execute(
+            "UPDATE budget_reservations SET amount='0',state='RELEASED',resolved_at=? "
+            "WHERE account_scope_id=? AND reservation_id=? AND state='ACTIVE'",
+            (to_db_timestamp(now), self._writer.account_scope_id, f"rsv:{intent_id}"),
+        )
+
+    def _drift(self, conn, key, event, now, kind, expected, actual):
+        scope = self._writer.account_scope_id
+        run_id, drift_id = f"fill:{key}", uuid4().hex
+        if not conn.execute(
+            "SELECT 1 FROM reconciliation_runs WHERE account_scope_id=? "
+            "AND reconciliation_run_id=?",
+            (scope, run_id),
+        ).fetchone():
+            conn.execute(
+                "INSERT INTO reconciliation_runs(reconciliation_run_id,account_scope_id,status,"
+                "started_at,completed_at,summary_json) VALUES (?,?, 'DRIFTED',?,?,?)",
+                (
+                    run_id,
+                    scope,
+                    to_db_timestamp(now),
+                    to_db_timestamp(now),
+                    canonical_payload_json({"source": "fill_processor"}),
+                ),
+            )
+        conn.execute(
+            "INSERT INTO reconciliation_drifts(drift_id,account_scope_id,reconciliation_run_id,"
+            "drift_type,entity_ref,expected_json,actual_json,detected_at) "
+            "VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
+            (
+                drift_id,
+                scope,
+                run_id,
+                kind,
+                event.client_order_id,
+                canonical_payload_json(expected),
+                canonical_payload_json(actual),
+                to_db_timestamp(now),
+            ),
+        )
+        conn.execute(
+            "INSERT INTO entry_controls(account_scope_id,kill_switch_enabled,paused,reason,"
+            "updated_by,updated_at) VALUES (?,1,1,?,?,?) "
+            "ON CONFLICT(account_scope_id) DO UPDATE SET kill_switch_enabled=1,paused=1,"
+            "reason=excluded.reason,updated_by=excluded.updated_by,updated_at=excluded.updated_at",
+            (scope, f"reconciliation drift: {kind}", "fill_processor", to_db_timestamp(now)),
+        )
+        self._emit(
+            "ReconciliationDriftRecorded",
+            run_id,
+            {
+                "drift_id": drift_id,
+                "drift_type": kind,
+                "client_order_id": event.client_order_id,
+                "dedupe_key": key,
+            },
+            event.occurred_at,
+            f"fill-drift:{key}",
+        )
+        return ReconciliationDrift(
+            drift_id, kind, event.client_order_id, {"expected": expected, "actual": actual}
+        )
+
+    def _emit(self, event_type, stream_id, payload, occurred_at, idem):
+        return self._journal.append_in_transaction(
+            [
+                NewEvent(
+                    self._writer.account_scope_id,
+                    "fill_processor",
+                    str(stream_id),
+                    event_type,
+                    payload,
+                    occurred_at,
+                    idempotency_key=idem,
+                )
+            ]
+        )

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta
+from decimal import Decimal as D
+
+import pytest
+
+from mike_trade.domain.accounts import AccountEnvironment, AccountScope
+from mike_trade.domain.trading import (
+    BrokerOrder,
+    BrokerOrderStatus,
+    BudgetPolicy,
+    OrderIntent,
+    OrderPurpose,
+    OrderSide,
+    OrderType,
+    PositionCycle,
+    TimeInForce,
+)
+from mike_trade.execution.fill_processor import FillEvent, FillProcessor, OrderUpdateEvent
+from mike_trade.execution.order_fsm import OrderStatus
+from mike_trade.persistence.repositories import (
+    AccountScopeRepository,
+    BrokerOrderRepository,
+    OrderIntentRepository,
+    PositionCycleRepository,
+)
+from mike_trade.persistence.schema import initialize_database
+from mike_trade.persistence.transaction import WriterSession
+
+NOW = datetime(2026, 10, 8, 14, 30, tzinfo=UTC)
+SCOPE = AccountScope(AccountEnvironment.PAPER, "ACCT")
+
+
+class Clock:
+    def now(self):
+        return NOW
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def env(tmp_path):
+    path = tmp_path / "ledger.db"
+    initialize_database(path, AccountEnvironment.PAPER, now=NOW).close()
+    session = WriterSession(path)
+    writer = session.bind_scope(SCOPE.scope_id)
+    AccountScopeRepository(writer, Clock()).register_scope(SCOPE)
+    cycles = PositionCycleRepository(writer, Clock())
+    intents = OrderIntentRepository(
+        writer,
+        Clock(),
+        BudgetPolicy(
+            per_symbol_budget=D("100000"),
+            total_application_budget=D("100000"),
+            max_open_positions=20,
+        ),
+    )
+    orders = BrokerOrderRepository(writer, Clock())
+    callbacks = []
+    processor = FillProcessor(writer, Clock(), callbacks.append)
+    yield session, writer, cycles, intents, orders, processor, callbacks
+    session.close()
+
+
+def add_order(
+    env, *, ident="1", side=OrderSide.BUY, qty="10", purpose=None, status=BrokerOrderStatus.ACCEPTED
+):
+    session, writer, cycles, intents, orders, processor, callbacks = env
+    cycle_id = f"cycle-{ident}"
+    cycles.open_cycle(
+        PositionCycle(cycle_id=cycle_id, account_scope_id=SCOPE.scope_id, symbol="XYZ")
+    )
+    purpose = purpose or (
+        OrderPurpose.ENTRY if side is OrderSide.BUY else OrderPurpose.STRATEGY_EXIT
+    )
+    intent = OrderIntent(
+        intent_id=f"intent-{ident}",
+        client_order_id=f"client-{ident}",
+        account_scope_id=SCOPE.scope_id,
+        cycle_id=cycle_id,
+        symbol="XYZ",
+        side=side,
+        purpose=purpose,
+        order_type=OrderType.MARKET,
+        time_in_force=TimeInForce.DAY,
+        created_at=NOW,
+        quantity=D(qty),
+    )
+    receipt = intents.record_intent(intent, D("1000") if purpose is OrderPurpose.ENTRY else D("0"))
+    order = BrokerOrder(
+        broker_order_id=f"broker-{ident}",
+        client_order_id=intent.client_order_id,
+        account_scope_id=SCOPE.scope_id,
+        symbol="XYZ",
+        side=side,
+        order_type=OrderType.MARKET,
+        status=status,
+        quantity=D(qty),
+        filled_quantity=D("0"),
+        submitted_at=NOW,
+        updated_at=NOW,
+    )
+    orders.upsert_broker_order(order, intent_id=receipt.intent.intent_id)
+    return intent
+
+
+def ev(client, id, *, qty=None, cumulative=None, price=None, avg=None, side=None, at=NOW):
+    return FillEvent(
+        client_order_id=client,
+        event_id=id,
+        occurred_at=at,
+        quantity=None if qty is None else D(qty),
+        cumulative_qty=None if cumulative is None else D(cumulative),
+        price=None if price is None else D(price),
+        average_price=None if avg is None else D(avg),
+        side=side,
+    )
+
+
+def rows(writer, sql, args=()):
+    return writer.connection.execute(sql, args).fetchall()
+
+
+def test_single_full_fill_updates_order_position_and_decimal_cost_basis(env):
+    add_order(env)
+    result = env[5].ingest(ev("client-1", "fill-1", cumulative="10", avg="12.35"))
+    assert result.incremental_qty == D("10")
+    assert result.order_status is OrderStatus.FILLED
+    position = rows(env[1], "SELECT quantity,average_entry_price FROM positions")[0]
+    assert tuple(map(D, position)) == (D("10"), D("12.35"))
+    order = rows(env[1], "SELECT filled_quantity,filled_avg_price FROM broker_orders")[0]
+    assert tuple(map(D, order)) == (D("10"), D("12.35"))
+
+
+def test_multiple_partial_fills_use_decimal_weighted_average(env):
+    add_order(env)
+    env[5].ingest(ev("client-1", "a", qty="3", price="10.10"))
+    env[5].ingest(ev("client-1", "b", qty="7", price="10.20"))
+    order = rows(env[1], "SELECT filled_quantity,filled_avg_price FROM broker_orders")[0]
+    assert tuple(map(D, order)) == (D("10"), (D("3") * D("10.10") + D("7") * D("10.20")) / D("10"))
+    assert D(rows(env[1], "SELECT quantity FROM positions")[0][0]) == D("10")
+
+
+def test_partial_cancel_releases_unused_reservation(env):
+    add_order(env)
+    env[5].ingest(ev("client-1", "partial", qty="4", price="20"))
+    env[5].ingest(OrderUpdateEvent("client-1", "CANCELED", NOW, event_id="cancel"))
+    reservation = rows(env[1], "SELECT state,amount FROM budget_reservations")[0]
+    assert tuple(reservation) == ("RELEASED", "0")
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("status", ["REJECTED", "CANCELED", "EXPIRED"])
+def test_terminal_zero_fill_releases_reservation(env, status):
+    add_order(env)
+    env[5].ingest(OrderUpdateEvent("client-1", status, NOW, event_id=status))
+    assert tuple(rows(env[1], "SELECT state,amount FROM budget_reservations")[0]) == (
+        "RELEASED",
+        "0",
+    )
+    assert rows(env[1], "SELECT * FROM fills") == []
+
+
+def test_duplicate_and_restart_reingestion_are_noops(env):
+    add_order(env)
+    event = ev("client-1", "stable-fill", qty="4", price="25")
+    applied = env[5].ingest(event)
+    assert applied.outcome == "APPLIED"
+    assert env[5].ingest(event).outcome == "DUPLICATE"
+    path = env[0].connection.execute("PRAGMA database_list").fetchone()[2]
+    env[0].close()
+    restarted = WriterSession(path)
+    try:
+        p = FillProcessor(restarted.bind_scope(SCOPE.scope_id), Clock())
+        assert p.ingest(event).outcome == "DUPLICATE"
+        assert D(restarted.connection.execute("SELECT quantity FROM positions").fetchone()[0]) == D(
+            "4"
+        )
+        assert D(
+            restarted.connection.execute("SELECT amount FROM budget_reservations").fetchone()[0]
+        ) == D("600")
+    finally:
+        restarted.close()
+
+
+def test_out_of_order_cumulative_fills_reconcile_by_quantity(env):
+    add_order(env)
+    env[5].ingest(ev("client-1", "cum-6", cumulative="6", avg="10"))
+    env[5].ingest(
+        ev("client-1", "cum-3-old", cumulative="3", avg="9", at=NOW - timedelta(seconds=1))
+    )
+    order = rows(env[1], "SELECT filled_quantity,filled_avg_price FROM broker_orders")[0]
+    assert tuple(map(D, order)) == (D("6"), D("10"))
+    assert D(rows(env[1], "SELECT quantity FROM positions")[0][0]) == D("6")
+
+
+def test_accepted_does_not_change_quantity_and_cancel_pending_fill_is_applied(env):
+    add_order(env)
+    env[5].ingest(OrderUpdateEvent("client-1", "ACCEPTED", NOW, event_id="accepted"))
+    assert D(rows(env[1], "SELECT filled_quantity FROM broker_orders")[0][0]) == D("0")
+    env[5].ingest(OrderUpdateEvent("client-1", "PENDING_CANCEL", NOW, event_id="cancel-request"))
+    result = env[5].ingest(ev("client-1", "race-fill", qty="2", price="10"))
+    assert result.order_status is OrderStatus.PARTIALLY_FILLED
+    assert D(rows(env[1], "SELECT quantity FROM positions")[0][0]) == D("2")

            "quote_reference_time",

            "notional",

def _require_text(value: Any, *, field: str) -> str:
    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():

    return value.strip()


def _optional_text(value: Any, *, field: str) -> str | None:
    if value is None:
        return None
    return _require_text(value, field=field)


def _decimal(value: Any, *, field: str) -> Decimal | None:
    if value is None:
        return None
    if isinstance(value, bool) or isinstance(value, float):
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be Decimal, int, or str")
    if isinstance(value, Decimal):
        result = value
    elif isinstance(value, int):
        result = Decimal(value)
    elif isinstance(value, str):
        try:
            result = Decimal(value.strip())
        except InvalidOperation:
            raise ValueError(f"{field} is not a valid decimal") from None
    else:
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be Decimal, int, or str")
    if not result.is_finite():
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be finite")
    return result


def _timestamp(value: Any, *, field: str = "timestamp") -> datetime:
    text = _require_text(value, field=field)
    if text.endswith("Z"):
        text = text[:-1] + "+00:00"
    try:
        parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(text)
    except ValueError:
        raise ValueError(f"{field} is not a valid timestamp") from None
    if parsed.tzinfo is None or parsed.utcoffset() is None:
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be timezone-aware")
    return parsed.astimezone(UTC)


def _environment(value: Any) -> AlpacaEnvironment:
    raw = getattr(value, "value", value)
    text = _require_text(raw, field="environment").upper()
    try:
        return AlpacaEnvironment(text)
    except ValueError:
        raise EnvironmentMismatchError(f"unknown Alpaca stream environment {text!r}") from None


def _decode_message(message: Any) -> Mapping[str, Any]:
    if isinstance(message, bytes):
        message = message.decode("utf-8")
    if isinstance(message, str):
        try:
            message = json.loads(message, parse_float=Decimal, parse_int=Decimal)
        except (json.JSONDecodeError, UnicodeDecodeError):
            raise ValueError("websocket message is not valid JSON") from None
    if not isinstance(message, Mapping):
        raise ValueError("websocket message must be a JSON object")
    return message


def _payload(message: Mapping[str, Any]) -> Mapping[str, Any]:
    stream_name = message.get("stream", message.get("T"))
    data = message.get("data")
    if stream_name == "trade_updates":
        if data is None:
            return message
        if not isinstance(data, Mapping):
            raise ValueError("trade_updates data must be a JSON object")
        return data
    # Accept an already-unwrapped fixture or transport payload.
    if "event" in message and "order" in message:
        return message
    raise ValueError("message is not a trade_updates event")


def _assert_message_scope(
    message: Mapping[str, Any],
    data: Mapping[str, Any],
    *,
    environment: AlpacaEnvironment,
    fingerprint: str,
) -> None:
    order = data.get("order")
    sources = [message, data]
    if isinstance(order, Mapping):
        sources.append(order)
    for source in sources:
        for name in ("environment", "account_environment", "source_environment"):
            if source.get(name) is not None and _environment(source[name]) is not environment:
                raise EnvironmentMismatchError(
                    f"trade update environment {source[name]!r} does not match "
                    f"session environment {environment.value}"
                )
        for name in ("fingerprint", "account_fingerprint"):
            if source.get(name) is not None and source[name] != fingerprint:
                raise EnvironmentMismatchError(
                    "trade update account fingerprint does not match stream session"
                )


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class TradeUpdate:
    environment: AlpacaEnvironment
    fingerprint: str
    event: TradeUpdateEvent
    raw_event: str
    order: AlpacaOrder
    timestamp: datetime
    execution_id: str | None = None
    price: Decimal | None = None
    qty: Decimal | None = None
    position_qty: Decimal | None = None
    reason: str | None = None
    raw: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None

    @classmethod
    def from_message(
        cls,
        message: Mapping[str, Any] | str | bytes,
        *,
        environment: AlpacaEnvironment,
        fingerprint: str,
    ) -> TradeUpdate:
        """Normalize one envelope (or already-unwrapped) trade update."""

        if not isinstance(environment, AlpacaEnvironment):
            raise TypeError("environment must be an AlpacaEnvironment")
        resolved_fingerprint = _require_text(fingerprint, field="fingerprint")
        envelope = _decode_message(message)
        data = _payload(envelope)
        _assert_message_scope(
            envelope,
            data,
            environment=environment,
            fingerprint=resolved_fingerprint,
        )
        raw_event = _require_text(data.get("event"), field="event").lower()
        event = _KNOWN_EVENTS.get(raw_event, TradeUpdateEvent.UNKNOWN)
        raw_order = data.get("order")
        if not isinstance(raw_order, Mapping):
            raise ValueError("trade update order must be a JSON object")
        return cls(
            environment=environment,
            fingerprint=resolved_fingerprint,
            event=event,
            raw_event=raw_event,
            order=_normalize_order(raw_order, environment=environment),
            timestamp=_timestamp(data.get("timestamp")),
            execution_id=_optional_text(data.get("execution_id"), field="execution_id"),
            price=_decimal(data.get("price"), field="price"),
            qty=_decimal(data.get("qty"), field="qty"),
            position_qty=_decimal(data.get("position_qty"), field="position_qty"),
            reason=_optional_text(data.get("reason"), field="reason"),
            raw=dict(envelope),
        )

    @property
    def is_unknown(self) -> bool:
        return self.event is TradeUpdateEvent.UNKNOWN

    @property
    def incremental_qty(self) -> Decimal | None:
        """Execution quantity in this message (distinct from order.filled_qty)."""

        return self.qty

    @property
    def cumulative_qty(self) -> Decimal | None:
        return self.order.filled_qty

def _require_int(value: object, *, field: str, minimum: int) -> int:
    if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, int):
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be int")
    if value < minimum:
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be >= {minimum}")
    return value


def _require_duration(value: object, *, field: str) -> timedelta:
    if not isinstance(value, timedelta):
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be timedelta")
    if value < timedelta(0):
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be >= 0")
    return value


def _validate_order_prices(
    order_type: OrderType,
    limit_price: Decimal | None,
    stop_price: Decimal | None,
    trail_price: Decimal | None,
    trail_percent: Decimal | None,
) -> None:
    if order_type in {OrderType.LIMIT, OrderType.STOP_LIMIT}:
        if limit_price is None:
            raise ValueError(f"{order_type.value} orders require limit_price")
    elif limit_price is not None:
        raise ValueError(f"{order_type.value} orders must not specify limit_price")

    if order_type in {OrderType.STOP, OrderType.STOP_LIMIT}:
        if stop_price is None:
            raise ValueError(f"{order_type.value} orders require stop_price")
    elif stop_price is not None:
        raise ValueError(f"{order_type.value} orders must not specify stop_price")

    trail_count = int(trail_price is not None) + int(trail_percent is not None)
    if order_type is OrderType.TRAILING_STOP:
        if trail_count != 1:
            raise ValueError("TRAILING_STOP orders require exactly one trail value")
    elif trail_count:
        raise ValueError(f"{order_type.value} orders must not specify a trail value")

def _require_text(value: object, *, field: str) -> str:
    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a non-empty str")
    return value.strip()


def _require_symbol(value: object) -> str:
    symbol = _require_text(value, field="symbol").upper()
    if any(character.isspace() for character in symbol):
        raise ValueError("symbol must not contain whitespace")
    return symbol


def _require_decimal(
    value: object,
    *,
    field: str,
    minimum: Decimal = _ZERO,
    inclusive: bool = True,
) -> Decimal:
    if not isinstance(value, Decimal):
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be Decimal; got {type(value).__name__}")
    if not value.is_finite():
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be finite")
    if value < minimum or (not inclusive and value == minimum):
        operator = ">=" if inclusive else ">"
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be {operator} {minimum}")
    return value


def _optional_decimal(
    value: object, *, field: str, positive: bool = True
) -> Decimal | None:
    if value is None:
        return None
    return _require_decimal(value, field=field, minimum=_ZERO, inclusive=not positive)


def _optional_utc(value: object, *, field: str) -> datetime | None:
    if value is None:
        return None
    if not isinstance(value, datetime):
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a datetime")
    if value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be timezone-aware UTC")
    if value.utcoffset() != timedelta(0):
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be UTC")
    return value.astimezone(UTC)

The journal deliberately depends on the documented ``domain_events`` table
contract rather than on the schema implementation.  Its three design choices
not fixed by that contract are:

1. ``expected_versions`` uses ``(stream_type, stream_id)`` keys and describes
   the committed stream head before this append (zero means a new stream).
2. Reusing an event ID for byte-for-byte equivalent event content is treated
   as a duplicate; reusing it for any different content is an error.
3. Payload containers may be mappings, lists, and tuples, and mapping keys must
   be strings so canonical ordering cannot depend on Python key coercion.

No row mutation is performed here.  Integrity verification reports evidence
of external tampering but never attempts to repair history.

def _canonical_value(value: Any, active_containers: set[int]) -> Any:
    if isinstance(value, Enum):
        return _canonical_value(value.value, active_containers)
    if value is None or isinstance(value, bool | int | str):
        return value
    if isinstance(value, float):
        raise JournalPayloadError("float values are not permitted in journal payloads")
    if isinstance(value, Decimal):
        if not value.is_finite():
            raise JournalPayloadError("non-finite Decimal values are not permitted")
        return str(value)
    if isinstance(value, datetime):
        if value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
            raise JournalPayloadError("naive datetimes are not permitted in journal payloads")
        return _format_timestamp(value)
    if isinstance(value, Mapping):
        identity = id(value)
        if identity in active_containers:
            raise JournalPayloadError("cyclic containers are not permitted in journal payloads")
        active_containers.add(identity)
        try:
            result: dict[str, Any] = {}
            for key, item in value.items():
                if not isinstance(key, str):
                    raise JournalPayloadError("journal payload mapping keys must be strings")
                result[key] = _canonical_value(item, active_containers)
            return result
        finally:
            active_containers.remove(identity)
    if isinstance(value, list | tuple):
        identity = id(value)
        if identity in active_containers:
            raise JournalPayloadError("cyclic containers are not permitted in journal payloads")
        active_containers.add(identity)
        try:
            return [_canonical_value(item, active_containers) for item in value]
        finally:
            active_containers.remove(identity)
    raise JournalPayloadError(
        f"unsupported journal payload value: {type(value).__name__}"
    )


def canonical_payload_json(payload: Mapping[str, Any]) -> str:
    """Serialize a payload into deterministic, lossless canonical JSON.

    ``Decimal`` values become strings, enum members become their values, and
    aware datetimes are normalized to UTC with six fractional digits.  Floats,
    non-finite decimals, naive datetimes, and unsupported objects are rejected.
    """
    if not isinstance(payload, Mapping):
        raise JournalPayloadError("journal payload must be a mapping")
    canonical = _canonical_value(payload, set())
    try:
        return json.dumps(
            canonical,
            sort_keys=True,
            separators=(",", ":"),
            ensure_ascii=True,
            allow_nan=False,
        )
    except (TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
        raise JournalPayloadError("journal payload cannot be encoded as JSON") from exc

def _format_timestamp(value: datetime) -> str:
    if value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
        raise JournalPayloadError("timestamp must be timezone-aware")
    return value.astimezone(UTC).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%fZ")


def _parse_timestamp(value: str) -> datetime:
    candidate = value[:-1] + "+00:00" if value.endswith("Z") else value
    parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(candidate)
    if parsed.tzinfo is None or parsed.utcoffset() is None:
        raise ValueError(f"stored timestamp is naive: {value!r}")
    return parsed.astimezone(UTC)

1. Fill identity and ledger.  ``Fill.fill_id`` *is* the broker's
   ``external_activity_id`` (``fills.fill_id`` is the surrogate
   ``"<scope>:<activity id>"``), and a fill's cycle is resolved through its
   broker order's intent.  ``broker_orders.filled_quantity`` is derived from the
   fills ledger and never decreases; broker snapshots older than the stored
   ``updated_at`` are ignored.
2. Reservation lifecycle.  Only ENTRY intents are budget-checked and reserve
   (``rsv:<intent_id>``); other purposes must pass a zero amount and never
   block.  An ACTIVE reservation's ``amount`` is the unconsumed remainder:
   entry fills consume it in proportion to the fill's share of the intent's
   remaining quantity (or notional), CONSUMED once the intent completes.  It is
   RELEASED when its order ends unfilled-in-part, its cycle closes, or a submit
   definitively fails.  Exposure is ACTIVE reservations plus open-position cost.
3. Submit outcomes.  ``BrokerRejectedError`` marks SUBMIT_FAILED (reservation
   released); any other exception marks UNKNOWN (reservation kept, since the
   order may exist).  The original exception is re-raised after the durable
   mark, success marks SUBMITTED, and only a RECORDED intent with no earlier
   submit-request event may be submitted.
4. Derived rows.  ``positions`` holds a row only for an open cycle (deleted on
   close) priced at the cycle's average entry.  Exit fills shrink active
   trailing coverage to the remaining quantity; entry fills never grow it.
   Closing marks the trailing state TRIGGERED if the filling order is its
   broker order, else CANCELED.
5. Entry controls.  Counters are keyed ``(symbol, session_date, strategy or '')``
   and carry ``consecutive_losses`` forward from the latest earlier row.  A
   loss is ``realized_pnl < 0``; anything else resets the streak.  Reaching the
   threshold inserts one indefinite lockout (``locked_until`` NULL) per
   ``(symbol, strategy scope)`` until cleared.
"""

class _Repository:
    """Shared plumbing: scope, clock, and same-transaction journal appends."""

    def __init__(self, writer: ScopedWriter, clock: Clock) -> None:
        self._w = writer
        self._clock = clock
        self._journal = DomainEventJournal(writer.connection, clock=clock)

    @property
    def _scope(self) -> str:
        return self._w.account_scope_id

    def _now(self) -> datetime:
        return _read_clock(self._clock)

    def _emit(
        self,
        event_type: str,
        stream_type: str,
        stream_id: str,
        payload: Mapping[str, Any],
        *,
        occurred_at: datetime | None = None,
        idempotency_key: str | None = None,
    ) -> RecordedEvent:
        result = self._journal.append_in_transaction(
            [
                NewEvent(
                    account_scope_id=self._scope,
                    stream_type=stream_type,
                    stream_id=stream_id,
                    event_type=event_type,
                    payload=payload,
                    occurred_at=occurred_at if occurred_at is not None else self._now(),
                    idempotency_key=idempotency_key,
                )
            ]
        )
        return result.recorded_events[0]

class AccountScopeRepository(_Repository):

            backtest_run = scope.scenario

            exists = conn.execute(

            ).fetchone()

                    "INSERT INTO account_scopes(account_scope_id, environment, broker, "
                    "broker_account_ref, scenario_name, run_id, created_at) "

                        scope.environment.value,
                        broker,
                        scope.account_id,
                        scope.scenario,
